entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ----

For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Soumitra Baraoi, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Bhola Nath Ojha, A.P.P.
 ----
 06/Dated: 17th January, 2024  1. Heard the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Pindrajora P.S. Case No.42 of 2020, registered for the offence under Sections 467, 468, 471, 406 & 420 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned C.J.M, Bokaro.
3. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that this applicant has purchased the land on the strength of sale deed.
The land, in question, has also been mutated.
He is not aware that the land, in question, belongs to the Forest Department.

Even as per the case,
this applicant comes under the category of the victim.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
5. Considering the above facts, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks Upendra Kunwar Sudhakar @ Upendra Kumar ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ...

1 from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M, Bokaro, in connection with Pindrajora P.S. Case No.42 of 2020,
subject to the condition as laid down under section 438(2) Cr.P.C.

Further, the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Raja/-
